# Run Order Demo

Command and Check blocks can run at the same time. This runbook shows the three cases where a block waits for another one.

## Outputs

`show-tag` uses an output of `build`, so its Run button is disabled until `build` has run. Run `build` a second time and `show-tag` waits again until it finishes.

<Command
  id="build"
  title="Build"
  command='sleep 5; echo "tag=v1.2.3" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
/>

<Command
  id="show-tag"
  title="Show the tag"
  command="echo Built {{ .outputs.build.tag }}"
/>

## dependsOn

`use-token` reads a variable that `log-in` exports. That isn't an output, so `use-token` names `log-in` in `dependsOn`.

<Command
  id="log-in"
  title="Log in"
  command="sleep 5; export DEMO_TOKEN=secret"
/>

<Check
  id="use-token"
  title="Use the token"
  dependsOn="log-in"
  command='test "$DEMO_TOKEN" = secret'
/>

## exclusive

`migrate` is `exclusive`. While it runs, no other block can start, and it can't start while another block is running.

<Command
  id="migrate"
  title="Migrate"
  exclusive
  dependsOn={["log-in", "use-token"]}
  command="sleep 5; echo migrated"
/>
